title: Transaction evidence — every state, its screenshot, its proof
kicker: representation lab · gastify transaction · real captures
card: One entity's full state flow with its evidence estate overlaid — 17 states, small-node diagrams left, the selected state's production capture + provenance right — grouped three ways (lanes · orbit · gates) so the operator picks the Evidence tab's left side with a letter.

handle: The diagram is the index; the screenshot is the evidence.
